articles.title: Building Telecom Language Models with RSOD: Domain Data, Specialist Post-Training, Memory-Conscious Distillation, and Networking Evaluation
articles.summary: The paper presents RSOD, a framework for building a telecom-specific language model by distilling six specialist LoRA teachers into one deployable student adapter on a shared Llama backbone. The resulting Llama-CalixCLM v1 model performs close to the combined routed-teacher system on held-out networking evaluations while using a single consolidated train-serve path.
articles.advisor_relevance: This is a technical but relevant signal that enterprise AI adoption is moving toward specialized, industry-specific models that can support operational workflows such as telecom routing, broadband services, access technologies, and diagnostics. The work also highlights practical deployment considerations, including model consolidation, LoRA adapters, and GPU resource usage, which are important for understanding how AI may diffuse into vertical software and network operations.
